title: Non-destructive DNA Extractions from Pinned or Preserved Arthropod Specimens
author: Axel David Gonzalez Murillo

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the lysis buffer with the following working concentrations for a 50 ml volume:

substeps.instruction: Add 50mM (2.5 ml) (hydroxymethyl) aminomethane hydrochloride (Tris) (pH 8.0)
Add 50mM (5 ml) Ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid (EDTA) (pH 8.0)
Add 2% (5 ml) Sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS) solution
Add 100mM (6.5 ml) NaCl
Add 0.50% (31.0 µl) Triton X-100
Optional: Add 50mM (2.5 ml) Sucrose (if used, reduce Triton X-100 volume accordingly)
Complete the 50 ml volume with nucleosfree water

steps.title: Prepare Specimens
steps.instruction: Prepare the pinned arthropod specimens for extraction.

substeps.instruction: Relax pinned specimens in a humidity chamber
Use sterile forceps to gently open the genital chamber and pierce the integumental membrane in the terminal abdominal segment of the adult specimen

steps.title: Lysis and Incubation
steps.instruction: Perform tissue lysis in centrifuge tubes.

substeps.instruction: Place each specimen into an individual new 2.0 ml Eppendorf centrifuge tube
Add 300 µL of lysis buffer and 15 µL of Proteinase K (20 mg/ml) to each tube
Incubate in a dry heat block at 52 °C to 55 °C for a minimum of 8 hours
Optional: Manually invert/revert specimens for at least 1 minute every 2 hours during incubation

steps.title: Recondition Silica Spin Columns (Optional)
steps.instruction: Recondition PuroSPIN MICRO Silica Spin Columns if they have been stored for more than 6 months.

substeps.instruction: Add 125 µL of 1N HCl to the silica column
Centrifuge for 1 minute at 13,000 × g and discard the eluent
Add 125 µL of lysis buffer to the column
Centrifuge for 1 minute at 13,000 × g and discard the eluent

steps.title: DNA Binding
steps.instruction: Bind the DNA to the silica column using binding buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL of binding buffer (containing 5M guanidine thiocyanate (135 ml), 5M sodium perchlorate monohydrate (135 ml), and absolute isopropanol (300 ml)) to the extraction tube containing the lysate
Invert the tube several times to mix thoroughly
Transfer the entire volume into a new or reconditioned silica spin column inserted into a 2 mL collection tube
Centrifuge for 30 seconds at 8,000 x g and discard the eluent

steps.title: Wash and Dry Column
steps.instruction: Wash the bound DNA and dry the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Perform two washes by adding 200-300 µL of wash buffer (10mM Tris, pH 8.0, 80% molecular grade or absolute ethanol) to the column
Centrifuge each wash for 30 seconds at 8,000 x g and discard the eluent after each spin
Dry the column membrane by centrifuging at 13,000 x g for 1 minute

steps.title: DNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the purified DNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Place the dried column into a fresh, clean 2 ml microcentrifuge collection tube
Add 50 µL of elution buffer (10 mM Tris; pH 8.0-8.5), pre-warmed to 55 °C for highest recovery, directly to the center of the silica membrane
Let the columns stand undisturbed for at least 1 minute
Centrifuge at 13,000 × g for 30 seconds to collect the purified DNA

steps.title: Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Measure the resulting DNA concentration using a Qubit 2.0 fluorometer with the dsDNA High Sensitivity assay, following the manufacturer's protocol.
